name: agent-workflow
description: Local-first orchestration platform that drives multiple opencode CLI processes as collaborating agents

scripts.lint: bun run --filter '*' lint && bun run lint:repo-ui
scripts.lint:repo-ui: eslint playwright.config.ts "e2e/**/*.ts" scripts/architecture-census.ts scripts/local-gate.ts scripts/rfc338-maintenance-soak.ts scripts/test-backend-sharded.ts --max-warnings=0 --cache --cache-strategy content --cache-location node_modules/.cache/eslint/repo-ui
scripts.format:check: prettier --check "packages/**/*.{ts,tsx,json,md}" --cache --cache-strategy content --cache-location node_modules/.cache/prettier/packages && bun run format:check:repo-ui
scripts.format:check:repo-ui: prettier --check package.json playwright.config.ts "e2e/**/*.{ts,md}" ".github/workflows/*.{yml,yaml}" scripts/architecture-census.ts scripts/local-gate.ts scripts/rfc338-maintenance-soak.ts scripts/test-backend-sharded.ts --cache --cache-strategy content --cache-location node_modules/.cache/prettier/repo-ui
scripts.test: bun run test:backend && bun run test:shared && bun run test:frontend && bun run test:system-mocks
